user.title: Wyze Lock Bolt
user.description: Enter the BLE address and the two 16-character local keys from your Bolt dump. Home Assistant will connect to the lock to verify the state key before finishing setup.

bluetooth_confirm.title: Wyze Lock Bolt discovered
bluetooth_confirm.description: Home Assistant discovered a {name} via Bluetooth ({mac}). You will need its 16-character state key and operate key from your Bolt dump to finish setup.

error.invalid_mac: Enter a MAC address such as 04:0D:84:1C:FC:15.
error.invalid_key: State key and operate key must each be exactly 16 ASCII characters.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the lock. Make sure it is in Bluetooth range, then try again.
error.invalid_state_key: The state key did not decrypt the lock's data. Double-check the key from your Bolt dump.
error.unknown: Unexpected error while talking to the lock.

abort.already_configured: This Wyze Lock Bolt is already configured.

init.title: Wyze Lock Bolt options
init.description: Choose how often Home Assistant reads the lock's state over Bluetooth. Persistent connection keeps a Bluetooth link open for fast commands and live state pushes, but this lock drops idle links after about 5 seconds (supervision timeout) -- set a keepalive interval (seconds) below to hold the link open with periodic reads. Keepalive and persistent mode both increase battery drain on the lock.

data.keepalive_interval: Keepalive interval, seconds (0 = off; persistent mode only)
